description: A real model's dashboard (deepseek-flash, the first live test): four cards in one column Stack with metrics, a progress bar, a horizontal bar chart, two tables and a callout. The terminal flows the cards into a grid and the metrics into a strip.

events.text:
Here's your disk usage:

```openui
root = Stack([diskCard, barCard, docsCard, cacheCard])
diskCard = Card([diskHeader, usageMetric, freeMetric, usageProgress, diskNote], "Disk /")
diskHeader = Header("Disk usage", "/dev/nvme0n1p3 · mounted on / and /home")
usageMetric = Metric("Used", "820 GB", "of 896 GB", "danger")
freeMetric = Metric("Free", "72 GB", null, "success")
usageProgress = Progress(0.92, "92% used")
diskNote = Text("`/home/moritz` alone holds 756 GB of that.", "muted")
barCard = Card([barHeader, topDirs], "Where the space goes (home)")
barHeader = Header("Top directories", "Home, GB")
topDirs = BarChart(["Documents", ".cache", ".config", ".local", "Games", "Pictures", "vms", "Downloads", "Other"], [Series("GB", [355, 65, 62, 60, 48, 25, 21, 17, 103])], true)
docsCard = Card([docsTable], "Documents breakdown")
docsTable = Table(["Path", "Size", "Share of Documents"], [["neoworks", "210 GB", "59%"], ["clients", "45 GB", "13%"], ["playingwithclouds", "19 GB", "5%"], ["curseforge", "18 GB", "5%"], ["personal", "16 GB", "5%"], ["other (6+ dirs)", "47 GB", "13%"]])
cacheCard = Card([cacheHeader, cacheTable, cacheCallout], "Cache — the cheap reclaim")
cacheHeader = Header(".cache", "65 GB total, mostly regenerable")
cacheTable = Table(["Cache", "Size", "Safe to delete"], [["uv", "18 GB", "Yes"], ["latent", "8.1 GB", "Probably"], ["go-build", "7.6 GB", "Yes"], ["ms-playwright", "3.2 GB", "Yes (re-download)"], ["huggingface", "3.2 GB", "Yes (re-download)"], ["spotify", "3.0 GB", "Yes"], ["yay", "2.9 GB", "Yes"], ["puppeteer", "2.0 GB", "Yes (re-download)"], ["zen", "1.9 GB", "Partly"], ["deno", "1.8 GB", "Yes"], ["rest", "13 GB", ""]])
cacheCallout = Callout("Deleting `.cache` content is safe — it's rebuilt on demand. Startup and first builds will be slower once.", "muted", "Note")
```
